scripts.dev: pnpm db:up && pnpm --filter @aetheria/shared build && concurrently -k -n shared,server,client "pnpm --filter @aetheria/shared dev" "pnpm --filter @aetheria/server dev" "pnpm --filter @aetheria/client dev"
scripts.build: pnpm --filter @aetheria/shared build && pnpm --filter @aetheria/server build && pnpm --filter @aetheria/client build
scripts.typecheck: pnpm --filter @aetheria/shared build && pnpm -r typecheck && tsc --noEmit -p tsconfig.tools.json
scripts.setup:local: pnpm db:up && pnpm db:generate && pnpm db:migrate && pnpm db:seed
scripts.db:seed: pnpm --filter @aetheria/shared build && pnpm --filter @aetheria/server exec prisma db seed
